'''Stanley Cohen''' (February 5, 1927 – March 27, 2017) was an American physicist who worked at Argonne National Laboratory. He created [[Speakeasy (computational environment)|Speakeasy]], a numerical computational environment, implemented with OOPS, object-oriented system, and was the founder and president of Speakeasy Computing Corporation.<ref>{{cite web|title=Stanley Cohen| date=28 March 2017 |url=http://www.legacy.com/obituaries/name/stanley-cohen-obituary?pid=1000000184729485&view=guestbook|publisher=Legacy|accessdate=11 April 2017}}</ref>
